basic_profile.bio: I'm a 17-year-old high school student from Southern California with a passion for skateboarding and video games. I love spending my weekends at the skate park or playing Red Dead Redemption 2. I'm also learning Italian to one day travel to Italy and explore the beautiful landscapes. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after school, especially after baseball practice. I'm single and focused on my studies and hobbies right now.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a decent understanding of skateboarding tricks and techniques, mostly self-taught from YouTube tutorials and practice. I'm also quite knowledgeable about video games, particularly sports and adventure genres, thanks to countless hours of gameplay.
